text:
Maria (PM): quick sync — canvassing launch slices for the Efficiency Adviser (batching, KV-prefix caching, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). I sketched three slices: Quick Win, Platform-Ready, and Enterprise-Guarded. Need feedback on acceptance criteria + infra deps.
Derek (Eng): love the slices. please call out infra primitives that must land early (prefix-cache, safe-quant pipeline, batching policy primitives). also include a tiny example DSL so we can estimate effort.
Sasha (ML): add model-concordance risk metric to every slice. propose nightly concordance check that flags >2% diff on eval set. for quant suggestions include a manual review gating flow.
Leo (Solutions): SEs will want an ROI calc. propose a 4-field CSV template (tokens/session, sessions/day, cost/token, expected % reduction). can we produce a one-pager to help field teams?
Maria (PM): good call. here's the draft detail I posted to the doc: 

Slice: Quick Win
- Audience: self-serve / small teams
- Features: read-only recommendations in Console, inline "apply" button for batching presets, CSV ROI template for SEs
- Acceptance: single feature-flag rollout, <1 extra API call per request when recommendations are enabled, basic telemetry for uptake
- Expected impact: ~8-15% token reduction for chat-heavy apps (heuristic batching + simple prefix caching)
- Risks: limited tuning surface, noisier recommendations initially

Slice: Platform-Ready
- Audience: ops/platform teams
- Features: configurable batching presets (DSL), KV-prefix caching policies, safe quant suggestion engine (preset profiles), nightly eval-triggered alerts (severity: info/warn/critical) delivered to console + Sentry
- Acceptance: documented SLO tradeoffs, toggle to throttle or mute suggestions per-tenant, visible eval diffs in UI
- Expected impact: ~20-35% cost reduction on batchy workloads; p95 may increase due to batching windows
- Risks: needs autoscaler tuning; extra oncall surface for early adopters

Slice: Enterprise-Guarded
- Audience: Dedicated/Private customers with strict controls
- Features: API for recommendation automation, canary-by-tenant, automated quant suggestion with diff reports and signed approvals, eval-triggered auto-hold/backout workflow, config-as-code integrations, KMS/HSM audit compatibility
- Acceptance: audit logs for every recommendation, SLIs for auto-backout thresholds, security signoff, integration tests for KMS paths
- Expected impact: 25-50% cost savings for high-volume flows while preserving SLAs
- Risks: longer eng and compliance runway, integration effort with on-prem stacks

Derek (Eng): sample batching policy DSL to show complexity estimate: ```
batch_policy:
  id: session_window
  max_delay_ms: 40
  max_tokens: 4096
  grouping_key: session_id
  prefer_low_latency: false
```
Sasha (ML): sample nightly eval snippet for quant suggestions: ```
# validation harness
orig = run_model(validation_set)
quant = run_quant_model(validation_set)
concordance = compute_concordance(orig, quant)
if concordance < 98.0:
  create_alert('quant-suspect', details=summary_stats)
```
Leo (Solutions): for ROI one-pager include two customer vignettes (AcmeHealth, Shoply) and the CSV template. long-term: embed a one-click estimator in Console with sample dataset upload. short-term: SE scripts + CSV.
Jamie (ProdDev): agreed. I'll put acceptance checklist into tickets and tag security for the Enterprise slice. checklist items: KMS integration, audit log entries, signed approval step, SLI thresholds, rollback plan.
Maria (PM): prioritization: we can do two Q3 deliverables. proposed order: 1) Quick Win (fastest customer-facing value), 2) Platform-Ready (highest impact). Enterprise-Guarded to Q4. objections?
Derek (Eng): thumbs up but mark infra deps as blockers in stories. prefix-cache and safe-quant pipelines should be early tasks.
Sasha (ML): I'll author the eval taxonomy: sample-level (data drift), model-level (concordance drop), infra-level (batch latency spike). map to severities and response playbooks.
Leo (Solutions): alert noise is a big ask from customers. default thresholds must be conservative. provide advanced controls for power users.
Maria (PM): action items:
- Maria: finalize ROI CSV + one-pager (EOD Fri)
- Derek: branch prefix-cache + initial batch_policy proto (PR by next Tue)
- Sasha: eval harness + taxonomy draft (sync Wed)
- Leo: SE one-pager + vignettes (demo Wed)
- Jamie: acceptance checklist in JIRA + security tag (add today)
ops-bot: created OPT-531 Efficiency Adviser slices (assignee: Maria)
Maria (PM): will lock the Q3 slice on Friday unless anyone raises blockers. keep comments here if you see conflicts. :thumbsup: 
Derek (Eng): will flag infra blockers by Thu EOD.
Sasha (ML): adding a small harness tomorrow.
Leo (Solutions): collecting customer usage samples for ROI inputs.
Jamie (ProdDev): adding checklist and security owners.
Maria (PM): finalize messaging: "Efficiency Adviser reduces token cost with safe, explainable recommendations." keep marketing simple.
Leo (Solutions): perfect. :rocket:
